name: StremioK
description: Stremio-addon streaming client for Samsung Tizen 3.0+ TVs: catalogs, sources and subtitles from your addons, Jellyfin/Emby/Plex, IPTV (M3U, Xtream, Stalker, TV guide), YouTube, USB and network folders (WebDAV, SMB, DLNA), Trakt and Stremio sync, Nuvio plugins, 17 languages. Hosts no media.
